QuestInfo.name: [Kritias] The Request of a Princess
QuestInfo.0: Speak to Princess Miriam while Parma is away!
QuestInfo.1: Miriam promises to tell you everything if you find the #bWorn Wooden Comb#k she lost when she fled the castle. Hunt #bburning#k monsters in the #bForest of Laments#k on the outskirts of Kritias to recover her lost wooden comb.
QuestInfo.2: You've recovered the wooden comb Miriam lost.

0.0: You're the odd one who kept buggin' Parma, aren't ya? I-I mean... Approach, adventurer. Let me see your face.\r\n#L0##b(Her hands are trembling.)#l\n#k
0.1: Oh... E-excuse me, hero. This has all b-been so frightening, and to make things worse, I lost my comb when I fled the castle. Pop made me that comb!\r\n#L0##bComb?#l\n#k

yes.0: Oh, thank you! I lost my #i4033938##b#t4033938##k somewhere near the #bForest of Laments#k.
yes.1: I thought I'd never see it again. If you get it back to me, you'll be my hero!

no.0: I understand. Why'd you risk your life for a nobody like me? I mean, a princess like me?

0.2: You're a hero, right? Could you fetch my #bWorn Wooden Comb#k from the woods? Please? Pretty please?

yes.0: I know it's nothing fancy, but I love this comb. Thank you.

item.0: I lost my #i4033938##b#t4033938##k near the #bForest of Laments#k. I bet a nasty old monster took it.
